githubDialog.customBody: Point ArduDeck at any existing empty repository over HTTPS. SSH URLs are converted to HTTPS automatically. The token needs read and write access to that repository (GitLab tokens: set username to "oauth2"). <link>Create an empty repository on GitHub</link> (set it to Private, don't add a README).
githubDialog.existingLabel: Existing repository (its history is kept; only possible while this vault is empty)
githubDialog.intro: ArduDeck backs up your parameter snapshots, missions and areas to an online repository. Everything keeps working offline; sync happens when you ask for it. Two ways to connect:
githubDialog.noAccount: No account yet? <link>Create one free at github.com</link>
githubDialog.option1Body: Easiest. ArduDeck creates a private repository for you. GitHub's approval page asks for repository access in general (that is how GitHub permissions work); ArduDeck only touches the one vault repository.
githubDialog.option2Body: No approval page. Create a token yourself (a fine-grained one limited to a single repository gives ArduDeck access to nothing else) and paste it here. <tokenLink>Open the token page</tokenLink> (choose "Only select repositories" and give Contents read and write), or read <guideLink>GitHub's step-by-step guide</guideLink>.
githubDialog.pickExisting: Or pick one of your existing repositories...
githubDialog.showAdvanced: Advanced: I already have a repository (GitHub, GitLab, self-hosted)
githubDialog.title: GitHub backup

vaultAutoSyncToggle.identityUnknownTip: Auto backup is on, but this vehicle could not be identified. Click to pick which vehicle you are working on in the vault.
vaultAutoSyncToggle.notConfiguredTip: Not backed up. Click to set up online backup in the vault.
vaultAutoSyncToggle.offTip: Automatic backup is off. Click to back up and sync after every save.
vaultAutoSyncToggle.onTip: This save is snapshotted and pushed to your repository automatically. Click to turn off.

vaultView.emptyBody: The vault keeps safe copies of your drone's settings, missions and survey areas, so you can always see what changed and go back.
vaultView.linkTip: Already snapshotted this vehicle under another name? Link it so history continues there.
vaultView.localOnly: Everything here is saved on this computer only. Turn on online backup to keep a copy off the machine and open the same missions and areas on another computer.
vaultView.saveBoundaryTip: Save the survey polygons on the map as this site's boundary
vaultView.saveMissionTip: Save the currently planned mission into this site
vaultView.sitlTip: Simulator snapshots, kept separate from real aircraft
vaultView.step1Body: Connect your drone and press "Snapshot vehicle params". Every setting is saved. Do it before and after you change anything.
vaultView.step2Body: Flying worse after a change? Open an old copy, see exactly which settings are different, and put them back with one click.
vaultView.step3Body: Connect a free GitHub account and your copies are backed up to the cloud and shared with your other computers.
vaultView.subtitle: Backup and history for settings, missions and survey areas ·
vaultView.title: Fleet Vault
vaultView.workingOnTip: Snapshots go to this vehicle. Auto detect uses the board id and profile.
